nodes.text: You wake up to the sound of heavy rattling. The entire apartment shakes to a steady rhythm. Magnetic wails against steel.
The morning train. Shaking your walls like the worst alarm clock ever. It's probably time to get up. Not like you can go back to sleep.
>> movelook (0,0,0) (0,0,0) << Home sweet home. A cheap ass room in the lower Mids. That's what scrapboy commission gets you these days.

You'd find a better job, but you'd rather have one really shitty job than three shitty jobs. Also, sometimes you strike gold and get a decent haul that you can ride for a month. It's like gambling with trash.
Still, it's a struggle to make rent every month, but you make do.
Luckily, it's your day off today. Time to burn the hours away before you know... another 50 hour week of mining trash.
